title: North Korean hackers behind $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist, says FBI
excerpt:
The theft of billions of dollars from Binance within a matter of minutes, the biggest crypto heist in history, was orchestrated by North Korean hackers, the FBI has said.
The bureau said in a statement on Saturday that this week's attack was tied to "malicious cyber activity" by an entity known as TraderTraitor, the same actors behind a USD 1.5 billion Bybit hack last year.
The FBI asked crypto exchanges, blockchain analytics companies and others to block transactions linked to various addresses to make sure the money is not laundered to cover up its origins.

ai.market_impact_te: ITC షేరు ధరపై నెగటివ్ ప్రెషర్ ఉండే అవకాశం ఉంది.
ai.impact_reason_te: సిగరెట్లపై పెరిగిన టాక్స్ కారణంగా కంపెనీ యొక్క మార్జిన్లు (margins) తగ్గి, మొత్తం లాభాలు (EBITDA) 20% వరకు పడిపోవడం ఖాయం. ఇది కంపెనీ యొక్క భవిష్యత్ ఆదాయ ప్రాజెక్షన్లను ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది.

title: FPIs pull out ₹34,843 cr from equities in Oct, turn net buyers last week
excerpt:
Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) withdrew Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities in October, marking the second consecutive month of heavy outflows, amid concerns over elevated crude oil prices, global interest rates and the corporate earnings outlook.
However, foreign investors turned net buyers towards the end of the month, infusing around Rs 6,300 crore during October 26-30 compared to net outflows of nearly Rs 2,700 crore in the week ended October 23.
According to data from the Central Depository Services Ltd (CDSL), FPIs withdrew Rs 35,861 crore in September. Before that, they had invested Rs 20,200 crore in July and Rs 29,631 crore in August.

The requirements are part of Sebi's earlier circulars on mandatory compliance with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, and the rules framed thereunder by all regulated entities.

ai.impact_reason_te: రుణ డిమాండ్ తగ్గితే బ్యాంకుల నెట్ ఇంటరెస్ట్ మార్జిన్ తగ్గి, లాభదాయకతపై ఒత్తిడి వస్తుంది; ఇది పెట్టుబడిదారుల భావనను తగ్గిస్తుంది.
